physical_configuration.description: Quiet K dwarf transited by an isolated sub-Earth-mass planet
physical_configuration.limb_darkening: Fixed linear a1=.4, an illustrative band-averaged profile; not derived from the flux-only CK04 spectrum
physical_configuration.exposure_scope: Top-hat average over the nominal 66-second exposure; detector ramp weighting is not modeled
physical_configuration.observer: Rectilinear short-event approximation; no sampled annual parallax or mass inference
physical_configuration.anchor_scope: Photon+effective-background S/N before adding the assumed independent 1 mmag floor
physical_configuration.noise_scope: Known independent Gaussian errors from source+blend Poisson counts, constant effective background/read variance calibrated to S/N=100 at F146_AB=21.2, and an assumed independent 1 mmag floor. Not a pixel-level or crowded-field instrument forecast.
physical_configuration.blend_scope: Unrelated unresolved background light with fixed injected source fraction; no luminous planet contribution
physical_configuration.saturation_scope: Representative centered SCA01/K0V PSF pixel and total-brightness guard; not a full SED/subpixel/MA-ramp ETC calculation

roman_f146_sca01_effective_area.csv.description: NASA Roman effective area, SCA01, 2024-03-01 model. Extracted wavelength/F146 columns over 0.85–2.10 micron; no throughput rescaling.

ck04_5000_4000_logg4p5_solar.csv.description: STScI Castelli & Kurucz 2004 ATLAS9 surface-flux grids at 5000 K (photosphere) and 4000 K (spot), [M/H] = 0, log g = 4.5. Native wavelength/g45 samples over 7500–23000 Angstrom, merged without resampling. Flux units erg s^-1 cm^-2 Angstrom^-1; multiply by (R/D)^2.
ck04_5000_4000_logg4p5_solar.csv.attribution: Castelli & Kurucz 2004; STScI atmosphere reference archive.
ck04_5000_4000_logg4p5_solar.csv.license: Publicly distributed numerical atmosphere grid; no explicit redistribution license was present in the FITS headers. No claim of a new license for these values.

configuration.outside_domain: NaN; rho=0 uses the analytic point-source limit

generation.provenance: Copied unchanged from the independently validated astrometry_methods_table_192.npz; no regeneration during packaging

experiment.injection_scope: Common finite-exposure mean; only the independent Gaussian noise seed varies

saturation.scope: Representative centered SCA01/K0V PSF pixel and total-brightness guard; not a full SED/subpixel/MA-ramp ETC calculation

experiment.noise_model: Known independent Gaussian errors from injected mean; photon/background/read approximation plus illustrative independent floor, no GP

flux_prior.scope: Allows negative source/blend flux. This is a common explicit prior for all methods, not the former positive logit-fraction/log-baseline prior.

experiment.marginalization: Controlled comparison of joint and marginalized versions of one Gaussian-flux target

lens_priors_transformed.density: Independent Gaussian in stated coordinates, truncated to common rho/ratio domain; affine sampler transform has constant Jacobian

timing_scope: Fresh sequential subprocess per formulation. Each pays its actual model construction, own MAP/exact Hessian, sampler setup, JIT, warmup and production. Interpreter/import startup, data loading, diagnostics, IO and conditional reconstruction are excluded; reconstruction is separately timed. One event and noise realization, not a universal speedup.
convergence_scope: Common ESS>=1000 for four physical lens parameters. R-hat<1.01 and >=50 autocorrelation times also required for the joint model's sampled fluxes. Zero divergences, zero maximum-depth saturations, finite sampler statistics, fixed caps/settings; failures are retained rather than relaxed.
agreement_scope: Distinct sampler seeds; differences of posterior means are scaled by combined chain MCSE. Marginal flux means use conditional-mean chains; their posterior variance includes conditional covariance. Finite-chain agreement is a diagnostic, not proof of equality or global posterior exploration.

conditional_reconstruction.scope: One correlated Gaussian (f_s,f_b) draw per retained geometry state, using that method's own exposure-averaged magnification. Reconstruction and summaries are outside sampler timing. Flux samples have conditional uncertainty but no ESS assigned.
conditional_reconstruction.probability_scope: Rao-Blackwell Monte Carlo means over retained geometry draws, including conditional variance. Zero can be floating-point underflow; finite chains do not bound unsampled geometry-tail probability.

posterior_mean_agreement.scope: A finite Monte Carlo diagnostic across six means, not a formal proof or simultaneous confidence guarantee

formatting_provenance.ast_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 ast.dump(ast.parse(source), include_attributes=False), Python 3.12
formatting_provenance.scope: Formatting only after measurement; no algorithms, settings or measured outputs changed. Worker reports and their study_source_sha256 retain the exact executed bytes preserved in measured_compare.py.txt. Timings were not rerun.

plotting_provenance.scope: Figures use the saved chains, conditional moments and matching injected observations; sampling results, timings and diagnostics are unchanged. One correlated flux pair per retained lens draw.
